steps.text: Combine mashed strawberries, milk, cream, sugar, vanilla, salt, and food coloring in a large bowl.
Pour strawberry mixture into the freezer bowl of an ice cream maker; freeze according to the manufacturer's directions.
Transfer ice cream to an airtight container and freeze until firm.

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Strawberry Ice Cream
raw_recipe.description: This strawberry ice cream is egg-free and easy to make with mashed fresh strawberries, milk, and heavy cream for a delightfully fruity frozen dessert.
raw_recipe.name: Easy Strawberry Ice Cream

recipeInstructions.text: Combine mashed strawberries, milk, cream, sugar, vanilla, salt, and food coloring in a large bowl.
Pour strawberry mixture into the freezer bowl of an ice cream maker; freeze according to the manufacturer's directions.
Transfer ice cream to an airtight container and freeze until firm.

review.reviewBody: Since I am from Wisconsin an egg-based custard, as we call it, is what I'm used to. This recipe is proof that ice cream can be rich and delicious even without eggs! I scaled the servings to six so it would fit in my Cuisinart ice cream maker, using a ratio of 2 cups heavy cream to 1 cup half and half, which is what suits my tastes. I cut the vanilla back a bit (1 tsp. for a six serving recipe) and didn't use the food coloring. I added an extra half cup of strawberries, pureeing the first 1-1/2 cups, then just mashing the extra half cup. I didn't want the chunks too big as I know they just become icy and hard. Between the recipe itself and the slight changes I made I found this just perfect--I'm glad I cut back on the vanilla, as I didn't want it to interfere with the simple flavors of strawberries and cream on their own. Also, using the ratio of heavy cream and half and half as I do ensures a rich and creamy ice cream with a smooth mouth feel. The amount of sugar the recipe calls for is just right. I added the salt as well, knowing it heightens flavors and makes it come to life, tho' this could easily be omitted. This is such a basic and easy recipe that it would work equally as well with other fruits, maybe only having to adjust the sugar depending on the sweetness of the fruit. Nothing's better than a cooked, frozen custard, but this quick and easy ice cream is a fine runner-up!

First time making strawberry ice cream. I watched some videos on different ingredients and methods. I have a 2 quart Whynter ice cream machine. Excellent recipe. It's delicious. But for me there's a big learning curve. I used fresh strawberries. I smashed them but not enough. Chunks of strawberries were hard. I should have pureed them since these were not ripe. That was about the only con and it wasn't the recipe fault, it's my lack of experience. I did add a teaspoon of Xanthan Gum to the sugar before mixing all ingredients. Not any ice crystals, it was smooth and creamy. I will make this again. Next time I think I might cook down the strawberries and cool them or use a jar of my homemade strawberry jam. Wonderful recipe! Thanks for sharing. Highly recommended.

Wonderful flavor. I made this vegan with cashew cream and coconut cream (blended everything together then added minced strawberries) and it was delicious! I can't wait to try it with other seasonal fruit...

This was super easy! I soaked my cut berries in sugar overnight. I used 2 cups of mashed and about 1/2 cup chopped. I also used 3/4 cup sugar and a scant 1/4 cup corn syrup. This eliminated the milk like texture people have talked about. I also added a tsp of vanilla and 1/4 tsp of strawberry extract. My kids have been devouring this. It’s quite good!

Excellent, added half a cup melted white chocolate chips in the mixture and half a cup unmelted when the ice cream was almost ready.

It came out awesome. Good texture and flavor. Super easy & hassle-free. Definitely making it again Thank you.

I quartered the strawberries and slowly added the heavy cream and used an immersion blender to break down the berries. Created a natural pink color. I put this in the freezer,added remaining cream,followed by remaining ingredients, and began churning process. Fabulous treat on a hot day. The berries were a perfect texture and very creamy. Delicious!

Priceless! I bought an ice cream maker at an estate sale for $12 and made the best strawberry ice cream ever. I cut my strawberries, covered them in a cup of sugar for several hours and puréed them in the blender. It was out of this world good.

AWESOME!!!! Omg delicious!!! And SUPER easy! Used my Cuisinart ice cream maker. It made a lot of ice cream, but was not in danger of overflowing. The only thing I did differently was added roughly chopped golden Oreos during the churning process and afterward crumbled them on top and added finely sliced frozen strawberries as well for a little garnish. My family LOVED it!!

I used three cups of half and half, one cup of organic whole milk, pureed strawberries to get the 1/1/2 cups, and then finely chopped 1/2 cup strawberries. Poured it in the cuisinart ice cream maker and started the machine. It over-flowed slightly. Taste was delicious and firmed up nicely in the freezer.

My go to recipe! I love the fact that there are no eggs & no cooking. I add 3T of vodka to keep it from getting too hard. I’ve also found a recipe for roasted strawberries. It’s great because it removes a lot of the water from the berries. Because you add sugar to the strawberries I would use less sugar in the ice cream. I add them at the end of the freezing process.

I made this ice cream only this time I used a jar of Toschi Black Cherries in syrup and only added 1/4 cup of sugar since the jar of cherries is so sweet! Before the entire mixture was ready to come out of my electric ice cream maker I added 1/4 cup of the remaining cherries. This was delish!
Quick and easy. This is a great recipe!
This was so easy and delicious! The family all loved it including the dog !

The only recipe you need. In fact remove the strawberry and the plain vanilla is the perfect base for any flavor or mix ins you wanna add! We ate it after 5 hours of setting in the freezer it was perfect for a soft serve texture. 24 hours later it set up perfectly hard. I have never made ice cream from scratch until yesterday afternoon. Anyone can do this!!

I have an ice cream maker attachment for my Kitchen Aid. The recipe is super simple. There were a few changes, used 2 cups of frozen cherries chopped, cut the sugar to 2/3 cup, and added Malt Flavoring. It turned out amazing.

Super easy and delicious recipe. I always substitute canned coconut milk for regular milk ( love the flavor addition). Mixed up and froze perfectly. Made it for a friend’s game night. It was a huge success!
Yum yum great recipe totally recommend
OMG. fresh picked strawberries, this was THE BEST!!! after it freezes ypu have to let it sit out for a bit, it will get much creamier and not so chunky & dry. OMG!!!!
I followed the recipe with no changes and it was fantastic. Super creamy.
I had to do two batches in my kitchen aid ice cream attachment but it worked out great!
